comments.value: As stated in our Blog post (https://medium.com/@vrchat/vrchat-valve-index-support-and-the-gesture-toggle-system-742ec3ae016e) this is the eventual plan. We're working on implementing as much of the Index Controller featureset (such as Gesture Toggle or limited finger "tracking") into other controllers as the hardware permits.
@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: Glad to hear! Definitely excited for that feature on my Rift! :3
@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: excellent to hear this! the gesture toggling alone would be amazing, anything to add to/improve the gesture system is awesome

Please make sure that Index controller functionality is working for other headsets such as the Pimax 8K/5K+ - https://vrchat.canny.io/bug-reports/p/index-controllers-pimax-hmds-finger-tracking-and-controller-bindings-not-working

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: Gesture toggle for everyone please. As someone who has made a hello world app before it seems like it would be easy to implement but what do I know. I understand you guys are a small team but can you please put this in plzzzzz. Much love and thank you all for the hard work you put into this wonderful game.
Gesture Toggle is now available through the Action Menu on all platforms!

details:
Pretty much the title~

Right now, it should be obvious, it's not in the beta. But controllers such as the Rift and WMR definitely have the capability for some basic finger tracking, even if the middle, ring, and pinky are all on the same button. It'd still be a godsend for people like me who use sign language as a communication method in VRC.

Plus the gesture toggle system looks so useful! Being able to separate my fingers and my facial expressions!
title: [785]Gesture Toggle & Tracking for other controllers
